headline: DATA ANALYST | ML/AI ENGINEER IN TRAINING
summary: Data Analyst with nearly 4 years of experience building automated data pipelines, interactive dashboards, and business intelligence solutions, currently advancing into ML/AI Engineering. Demonstrated ability to design end-to-end data workflows — from raw data ingestion (PostgreSQL, MySQL) through cleaning, multi-table integration, feature engineering, and automated EDA report generation (HTML/Plotly). Built and deployed a supervised churn-prediction model on a 112,650-row e-commerce dataset using Scikit-learn. Skilled in translating complex datasets into clear, actionable KPI visualizations and ML-ready features for technical and non-technical stakeholders. Currently completing intensive AI/ML/DS training (LogicMojo, 60 sessions through Sep 2026) covering Deep Learning, NLP, Transformers, LLMs, and RAG architectures, alongside the IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate.
